Definition: properly, to tear the hair and beat the breasts (as Orientals do in grief); generally to lament; by implication, to wail
BiblicalUsage: 1) to wail, lament, mourn; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to wail, lament; 1a2) wailers (participle); 1b) (Niphal) to be lamented, be bewailed
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
